rules.statement: The Court must endeavour to compel the parties to bring a partition action to a termination, and may only dismiss the action if the parties, duly represented, are not prosecuting the appeal with due diligence.
rules.supporting_quote: In my opinion, this being a partition action, the Court must endeavour to compel the parties to bring the action to a termination: it may dismiss this action only in the event of the parties, duly represented, not prosecuting the appeal with due diligence.
